lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF can sell up to ₹3.41 crore in the offer, if all offered shares are sold; the sale price is ₹1,352 per share.
Timing: the money is already in hand since 11 Mar 2026, and the shares were unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago.
Gain of up to ₹2.52 crore before offer expenses and taxes; the employee-portion discount means actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The retained stake is worth an estimated ₹7.95 crore at offer price; the confidence is medium, as holdings appear in one section only.
